question: Could you provide the annual percentage shares, rounded to two decimal places, of the top 5 minor crime categories from 2008 in London's total crimes, with each year displayed in one row?
sql:
WITH yearly_totals AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    SUM(value) AS total_crimes
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year
),
category_yearly AS (
  SELECT 
    year,
    minor_category,
    SUM(value) AS category_count
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.london_crime.crime_by_lsoa`
  GROUP BY year, minor_category
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    c.year,
    c.minor_category,
    c.category_count,
    t.total_crimes,
    SAFE_DIVIDE(c.category_count * 100.0, t.total_crimes) AS pct_share,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.year ORDER BY c.category_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM category_yearly c
  JOIN yearly_totals t ON c.year = t.year
)
SELECT 
  year,
  minor_category,
  category_count,
  total_crimes,
  ROUND(pct_share, 2) AS pct_share
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 5
ORDER BY year, rn
